targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at AS "time", COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS value FROM observability_runs WHERE status = 'ok' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM observability_runs WHERE status = 'ok' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT stage, duration_ms::double precision AS duration_ms
FROM latest,
LATERAL (VALUES
  ('download_prices', download_ms),
  ('normalize_prices', normalize_ms),
  ('analysis', analysis_ms),
  ('store_prices', store_prices_ms),
  ('store_indicators', store_indicators_ms),
  ('grafana_query', grafana_query_ms),
  ('browser_render', browser_render_ms)
) AS stages(stage, duration_ms)
WHERE duration_ms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY duration_ms DESC;

WITH runs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS latency_ms
  FROM observability_runs
  WHERE status = 'ok'
    AND COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms) IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS samples FROM runs
)
SELECT p.percentile, p.latency_ms::double precision AS latency_ms, stats.samples
FROM stats,
LATERAL (
  SELECT 'p50' AS percentile, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS latency_ms FROM runs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'p75' AS percentile, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS latency_ms FROM runs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'p95' AS percentile, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS latency_ms FROM runs
) p
WHERE stats.samples > 0
ORDER BY CASE p.percentile WHEN 'p50' THEN 1 WHEN 'p75' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

WITH selected_percentile AS (
  SELECT CASE '${percentile}' WHEN 'p75' THEN 0.75 WHEN 'p95' THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.50 END AS q
), runs AS (
  SELECT
    completed_at,
    run_id,
    trace_id,
    COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS critical_path_ms,
    download_ms::double precision AS download_ms,
    normalize_ms::double precision AS normalize_ms,
    analysis_ms::double precision AS analysis_ms,
    store_prices_ms::double precision AS store_prices_ms,
    store_indicators_ms::double precision AS store_indicators_ms,
    grafana_query_ms::double precision AS grafana_query_ms,
    browser_render_ms::double precision AS browser_render_ms,
    dominant_stage,
    reason_code,
    reason_summary
  FROM observability_runs
  WHERE status = 'ok'
    AND COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms) IS NOT NULL
), target AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT q FROM selected_percentile)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY critical_path_ms) AS target_ms
  FROM runs
), nearest AS (
  SELECT r.*, ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms) AS distance_ms, t.target_ms
  FROM runs r
  CROSS JOIN target t
  WHERE t.target_ms IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms), r.completed_at DESC
  LIMIT 5
)

, reason_rank AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(reason_code, 'unknown') AS reason_code,
    COALESCE(reason_summary, 'No reason summary recorded') AS reason_summary,
    COUNT(*) AS reason_runs,
    AVG(critical_path_ms) AS reason_avg_ms
  FROM nearest
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  ORDER BY reason_runs DESC, reason_avg_ms DESC
  LIMIT 1
), aggregate AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS sample_runs, AVG(critical_path_ms) AS avg_latency_ms, MAX(critical_path_ms) AS max_latency_ms, MIN(target_ms) AS target_latency_ms
  FROM nearest
)
SELECT
  '${percentile}' AS percentile,
  aggregate.sample_runs,
  aggregate.target_latency_ms::double precision AS target_latency_ms,
  aggregate.avg_latency_ms::double precision AS avg_latency_ms,
  aggregate.max_latency_ms::double precision AS max_latency_ms,
  reason_rank.reason_code,
  reason_rank.reason_summary
FROM aggregate
LEFT JOIN reason_rank ON true;

WITH selected_percentile AS (
  SELECT CASE '${percentile}' WHEN 'p75' THEN 0.75 WHEN 'p95' THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.50 END AS q
), runs AS (
  SELECT
    completed_at,
    run_id,
    trace_id,
    COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS critical_path_ms,
    download_ms::double precision AS download_ms,
    normalize_ms::double precision AS normalize_ms,
    analysis_ms::double precision AS analysis_ms,
    store_prices_ms::double precision AS store_prices_ms,
    store_indicators_ms::double precision AS store_indicators_ms,
    grafana_query_ms::double precision AS grafana_query_ms,
    browser_render_ms::double precision AS browser_render_ms,
    dominant_stage,
    reason_code,
    reason_summary
  FROM observability_runs
  WHERE status = 'ok'
    AND COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms) IS NOT NULL
), target AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT q FROM selected_percentile)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY critical_path_ms) AS target_ms
  FROM runs
), nearest AS (
  SELECT r.*, ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms) AS distance_ms, t.target_ms
  FROM runs r
  CROSS JOIN target t
  WHERE t.target_ms IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms), r.completed_at DESC
  LIMIT 5
)

SELECT
  stages.stage,
  AVG(stages.duration_ms)::double precision AS avg_duration_ms,
  MAX(stages.duration_ms)::double precision AS max_duration_ms,
  COUNT(*) AS sample_runs
FROM nearest,
LATERAL (VALUES
  ('download_prices', download_ms),
  ('normalize_prices', normalize_ms),
  ('analysis', analysis_ms),
  ('store_prices', store_prices_ms),
  ('store_indicators', store_indicators_ms),
  ('grafana_query', grafana_query_ms),
  ('browser_render', browser_render_ms)
) AS stages(stage, duration_ms)
WHERE stages.duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY stages.stage
ORDER BY avg_duration_ms DESC;

SELECT price_time AS "time", symbol || ' close' AS metric, close::double precision AS value FROM stock_indicators WHERE price_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() UNION ALL SELECT price_time AS "time", symbol || ' ma20' AS metric, ma20::double precision AS value FROM stock_indicators WHERE price_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT symbol, price_time, close::double precision AS close, daily_return_pct::double precision AS daily_return_pct, ma20::double precision AS ma20, ma60::double precision AS ma60, volatility20::double precision AS volatility20, drawdown_pct::double precision AS drawdown_pct FROM stock_indicators WHERE price_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY price_time DESC, symbol LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  completed_at,
  mode,
  status,
  price_rows,
  indicator_rows,
  COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS critical_path_ms,
  pipeline_total_ms::double precision AS pipeline_total_ms,
  dominant_stage,
  reason_code,
  reason_summary,
  trace_id
FROM observability_runs
ORDER BY completed_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH selected_percentile AS (
  SELECT CASE '${percentile}' WHEN 'p75' THEN 0.75 WHEN 'p95' THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.50 END AS q
), runs AS (
  SELECT
    completed_at,
    run_id,
    trace_id,
    COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms)::double precision AS critical_path_ms,
    download_ms::double precision AS download_ms,
    normalize_ms::double precision AS normalize_ms,
    analysis_ms::double precision AS analysis_ms,
    store_prices_ms::double precision AS store_prices_ms,
    store_indicators_ms::double precision AS store_indicators_ms,
    grafana_query_ms::double precision AS grafana_query_ms,
    browser_render_ms::double precision AS browser_render_ms,
    dominant_stage,
    reason_code,
    reason_summary
  FROM observability_runs
  WHERE status = 'ok'
    AND COALESCE(critical_path_ms, total_ms) IS NOT NULL
), target AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT q FROM selected_percentile)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY critical_path_ms) AS target_ms
  FROM runs
), nearest AS (
  SELECT r.*, ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms) AS distance_ms, t.target_ms
  FROM runs r
  CROSS JOIN target t
  WHERE t.target_ms IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ABS(r.critical_path_ms - t.target_ms), r.completed_at DESC
  LIMIT 5
)

SELECT
  completed_at,
  run_id::text AS run_id,
  trace_id,
  critical_path_ms::double precision AS critical_path_ms,
  distance_ms::double precision AS distance_from_percentile_ms,
  dominant_stage,
  reason_summary,
  '/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%7D&orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22:%22tempo%22,%22queries%22:%5B%7B%22query%22:%22' || trace_id || '%22%7D%5D%7D' AS tempo_trace,
  '/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%7D&orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22:%22pyroscope%22%7D' AS pyroscope
FROM nearest
ORDER BY distance_ms, completed_at DESC;
